title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
description: Rich, silky fettuccine tossed in a savory garlic cream mushroom sauce with parmesan herbs.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve half a cup of pasta water.
In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and sauté for 6-8 minutes until golden browned.
Pour in the heavy cream and simmer gently for 2 minutes.
Toss cooked pasta and parmesan cheese with the sauce. Season with black pepper and parsley.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Velvety spiced tomato cashew gravy with succulent cubes of fresh paneer.
steps: Sauté onions, tomatoes, ginger and garlic in butter, then blend to a smooth puree.
Cook the spiced puree in a pan with garam masala and red chili powder until fragrant.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh paneer cubes; simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
Garnish with a dollop of butter and fresh coriander.

title: Classic Shakshuka
description: North African poached eggs in a vibrant spiced tomato, bell pepper, and garlic sauce.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Sauté chopped onions, bell peppers, and minced garlic until tender.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Make 3 small wells in the sauce and gently crack the eggs into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on low for 5-7 minutes until egg whites are set and yolks are runny.

title: Garlic Butter Spinach & Mushrooms
description: Quick, keto-friendly skillet of tender spinach and caramelized brown mushrooms.
steps: Melt butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add crushed garlic and sliced mushrooms. Cook until mushrooms turn deep golden brown.
Toss in washed fresh spinach and sauté for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt, cracked pepper and serve hot.

title: Fresh Tomato Basil Pasta
description: Bright Italian pasta with sweet bursting tomatoes, fragrant fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil.
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
In a pan, warm olive oil and gently fry sliced garlic until golden.
Add chopped ripe tomatoes and simmer until juices burst into a natural glossy sauce.
Toss the pasta directly in the sauce with torn basil and freshly cracked pepper.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Fragrant wok-tossed basmati rice with crunchy carrots, bell peppers, peas, and garlic.
steps: Cook rice and cool completely (or use leftover rice).
In a hot wok, heat oil and stir fry garlic and onions for 1 minute.
Add diced carrots and bell peppers, cooking on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce, and white pepper. Toss quickly until heated through.

title: Berry Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick chilled strawberry banana puree topped with fruit slices and crunchy seeds.
steps: Slice 1 banana and a few strawberries for topping.
Blend remaining banana, strawberries, milk, and curd into a thick frosty texture.
Pour into a bowl and garnish with reserved fruit slices.

title: Aloo Gobi Masala
description: Classic homestyle dry curry with roasted cauliflower florets and spiced tender potatoes.
steps: Cut cauliflower into florets and potatoes into cubes.
Heat oil in a pan, sauté cumin seeds, onions, and ginger until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, coriander powder, and chili powder.
Add cauliflower and potatoes, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until tender.
Finish with fresh coriander.

title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Juicy, tender chicken breast marinated with lemon zest, garlic, and fresh herbs.
steps: Pound chicken breast to even thickness.
Marinate with olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, salt, and black pepper for 15 minutes.
Sear on a hot grill pan for 6-7 minutes on each side until cooked through and nicely charred.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Greek Cucumber & Tomato Salad
description: Refreshing crisp Mediterranean salad with juicy tomatoes, crunchy cucumbers, and olive oil.
steps: Dice cucumbers and ripe tomatoes into bite-sized chunks.
Thinly slice red onions.
Toss together in a bowl with extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, oregano, and salt.
Serve chilled immediately.

title: Creamy Palak Paneer
description: Cottage cheese cubes bathed in smooth, vibrant spiced spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then plunge into ice water and puree.
Melt butter, sauté onions, garlic, and chopped tomato with spices.
Pour in the spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and finish with a swirl of heavy cream.

title: Egg Bhurji (Masala Scrambled Eggs)
description: Fiery Indian scrambled eggs cooked with sautéed onions, tomatoes, and green chilies.
steps: Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté chopped onions and green chilies until lightly golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and turmeric; cook until softened.
Pour in whisked eggs and gently scramble on medium-low heat until fluffy and soft.

title: Zucchini Tomato Gratin
description: Layers of tender sliced zucchini and tomatoes baked with garlic and bubbly melted cheese.
steps: Preheat oven or baking pan.
Arrange alternating slices of zucchini and tomatoes in a baking dish.
Drizzle with olive oil, minced garlic, herbs, and salt.
Top generously with shredded cheese and bake until vegetables are tender and cheese is bubbling golden brown.

title: Golden French Toast
description: Custard-dipped fluffy brioche slices cooked in golden butter, served with fresh fruit.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and a pinch of sugar in a shallow dish.
Dip bread slices on both sides to absorb the mixture.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry each side for 3 minutes until deep golden brown.

title: Homestyle Dal Tadka
description: Comforting yellow lentils tempered with ghee, cumin seeds, garlic, and red chilies.
steps: Pressure cook or boil lentils until soft and mashable.
In a separate pan, melt butter/ghee and fry cumin, garlic, and onions.
Add diced tomatoes and spices, cooking until softened.
Pour tadka over cooked dal and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Mango Lassi
description: Creamy, refreshing Indian yogurt drink blended with ripe sweet mangoes and cardamom.
steps: Peel and chop ripe sweet mango.
Combine mango, thick chilled curd, a splash of milk, and a pinch of cardamom in a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy. Serve chilled.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Silky slow-cooked arborio rice infused with garlic, sautéed mushrooms, and parmesan.
steps: Sauté mushrooms in 10g butter until browned, set aside.
In same pan, sweat onions and garlic in remaining butter.
Stir in rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Gradually add warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly until creamy and tender.
Fold in cooked mushrooms and parmesan.

title: Avocado & Sunny Poached Egg Toast
description: Creamy mashed avocado seasoned with lime and chili flakes on artisanal sourdough with a rich runny egg.
steps: Toast bread slices until deeply golden and crispy.
Mash avocado flesh with lemon juice, salt, and chili flakes.
Poach or fry eggs to desired doneness.
Spread avocado over toast and top with warm eggs.

title: Crispy Paneer Tikka Skewers
description: Char-grilled paneer cubes marinated in yogurt, ajwain, turmeric, and vibrant bell peppers.
steps: Whisk curd with spices, ginger garlic paste, and lemon.
Coat paneer cubes, bell peppers, and onion chunks in the marinade.
Thread onto skewers and pan sear or roast until slightly charred around edges.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle chaat masala.

title: Chickpea Spinach Mediterranean Stew
description: Hearty, nutrient-rich stew of protein chickpeas, tender spinach, and slow-simmered tomatoes.
steps: Warm olive oil in a deep pot and sauté minced garlic until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cumin, cooking into a sauce.
Stir in cooked chickpeas and 1 cup of vegetable broth; simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in fresh spinach until wilted.

title: Garlic Cheese Toast
description: Crunchy toasted bread infused with roasted garlic butter and molten stringy cheese.
steps: Mash softened butter with minced garlic and herbs.
Spread generously over bread slices.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake or pan-toast covered until cheese is bubbly and edges are crisp.

title: Rich Cream of Tomato Soup
description: Smooth, roasted tomato soup finished with a swirl of fresh cream and crunchy croutons.
steps: Sauté garlic and onions in butter.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, sugar, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend with an immersion blender until velvety smooth.
Strain if desired, stir in heavy cream, and season with black pepper.

title: Vegetable Pulao
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice cooked with whole spices, carrots, green beans, and peas.
steps: Wash and soak basmati rice for 15 minutes.
Sauté sliced onions, whole spices, and chopped veggies in oil.
Add rice and water in a 1:2 ratio.
Cook covered on low heat until water is absorbed and grains are fluffy.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Naturally sweetened fluffy golden pancakes prepared with ripe bananas and a touch of butter.
steps: Mash ripe bananas in a bowl until smooth.
Whisk in eggs and milk until a batter forms.
Ladle small circles onto a buttered skillet over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles appear on top, cooking until golden brown on both sides.

title: South Indian Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
description: Cooling, tempered rice folded into fresh curd with mustard seeds, ginger, and green chilies.
steps: Mash freshly cooked warm rice lightly with a spoon.
Mix in curd and milk with salt.
Temper mustard seeds, ginger, and green chili in a spoonful of oil.
Pour the seasoning over the curd rice and mix gently.

title: Tofu Veggie Stir Fry
description: High-protein crispy pan-fried tofu with colorful bell peppers and broccoli in a savory glaze.
steps: Press tofu dry, cut into cubes, and pan-fry until crisp.
Sauté garlic, broccoli florets, and bell peppers in a wok for 3-4 minutes.
Add tofu and drizzle with soy sauce, cooking for 1 minute until glazed.

title: Macaroni Cheese Bake
description: Tender elbow pasta enveloped in a velvety cheddar cheese bechamel, baked to bubbly perfection.
steps: Cook macaroni until al dente.
Make a roux by cooking butter and flour for 1 minute, then whisk in milk until smooth and thick.
Melt in shredded cheese and fold in pasta.
Transfer to dish and broil for 5 minutes until browned.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Sweet bell peppers roasted with a spicy filling of spiced potatoes, onions, and melted cheese.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with sautéed onions, cumin, and salt.
Halve bell peppers lengthwise and remove seeds.
Stuff peppers with potato mixture and top with cheese.
Bake or cook covered in skillet for 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Pepper Masala
description: South-Indian chettinad spiced curry featuring button mushrooms and crushed black peppercorn.
steps: Sauté onions and garlic in oil until translucent.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add sliced mushrooms, bell pepper cubes, and fresh crushed pepper.
Cook on medium high for 6-8 minutes until mushrooms are coated and tender.

title: Classic Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Golden crispy toasted sourdough packed with gooey, melted cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
steps: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place cheese between unbuttered sides.
Grill in a skillet on medium-low heat until bread is golden and cheese is completely melted.

title: Fresh Strawberry Milkshake
description: Chilled, thick and refreshing milkshake made with fresh strawberries and pure vanilla milk.
steps: Hull and rinse fresh strawberries.
Blend with chilled milk and cream until thick and smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

title: Paneer Bhurji Wrap
description: Spiced scrambled cottage cheese rolled inside warm flatbread with crunchy onion relish.
steps: Crumble fresh paneer with fingers.
Sauté onions, tomatoes, and green chilies in butter.
Add crumbled paneer, turmeric, and garam masala; toss for 3 minutes.
Fill into bread or roti, roll tightly, and enjoy warm.

title: Crispy Herb Potato Wedges
description: Seasoned golden potato wedges baked crisp on the outside and fluffy on the inside.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, and sea salt.
Spread on baking tray and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until crunchy and golden.

title: Vegetable Hakka Noodles
description: Street-style stir fried noodles with shredded cabbage, bell peppers, carrots, and spring onions.
steps: Boil noodles or pasta until just tender, drain and toss with a drop of oil.
In high-heat wok, stir fry julienned vegetables for 2 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and black pepper; toss vigorously for 1-2 minutes.

title: Vegetable Cheese Omelette
description: Fluffy beaten eggs packed with sautéed bell peppers, tomatoes, and melted gooey cheese.
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté finely diced peppers and tomatoes in butter for 1 minute.
Pour in beaten eggs and let set on low heat.
Sprinkle cheese on one half, fold over, and slide onto plate.

title: Lemon Honey Iced Tea
description: Brewed black tea infused with freshly squeezed lemon juice, honey, and crushed mint.
steps: Pour chilled iced tea into a tall glass over ice cubes.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice.
Garnish with a lemon wheel and mint leaf.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
description: Velvety soup loaded with tender broccoli florets and sharp cheddar cheese.
steps: Sauté grated carrots and garlic in butter.
Add milk and vegetable broth, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add chopped broccoli florets and cook until tender.
Remove from heat and melt in shredded cheese until smooth and creamy.

title: Avocado Tomato Salad with Lime
description: Creamy avocado chunks combined with sweet tomatoes, red onion, and fresh cilantro lime dressing.
steps: Dice avocado and tomatoes.
Toss gently with finely diced onion, fresh coriander, lime juice, and salt.
Serve immediately.

title: Simple Orange Sparkler
description: Freshly pressed sweet orange juice mixed with chilled sparkling water and crushed mint.
steps: Fill glass with ice.
Pour fresh orange juice and a squeeze of lemon.
Stir gently and enjoy.

title: Creamy Garlic Butter Salmon
description: Pan-seared tender salmon fillets nestled in a rich garlic butter cream sauce with fresh spinach.
steps: Season salmon with salt and pepper, sear in butter for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Remove salmon, sauté garlic in the pan, add spinach until wilted.
Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return salmon to skillet and baste with sauce.

title: South Indian Fish Curry (Meen Kulambu)
description: Tangy and spicy traditional fish curry simmered in tamarind tomato gravy with garlic.
steps: Sauté onions, whole garlic cloves, and tomatoes with curry powders in oil.
Add tamarind water and simmer until the gravy turns rich and fragrant.
Gently slide fresh fish pieces into the boiling curry.
Simmer on low for 6-7 minutes until fish is tender.

title: Vegetable Korma
description: Medley of garden vegetables cooked in a fragrant, mildly spiced coconut and cashew cream sauce.
steps: Boil mixed vegetables until tender-crisp.
Sauté onion paste with whole spices until aromatic.
Stir in pureed cashew cream and vegetables; simmer for 5-7 minutes.
